content.question: What is the effect of putting an additional penalty on the loss function for misclassifying the minority class?
options: It forces the model to pay more attention to the minority class and try to make fewer mistakes on it.
It reduces the number of minority samples in the training dataset.
It automatically generates new synthetic samples of the minority class.
It makes the model completely ignore the majority class.
content.answer: It forces the model to pay more attention to the minority class and try to make fewer mistakes on it.
